brief: Hoo! We finished The Whipping Boy! Pick your favorite scene from the whole book. Build it with four models, then take a photo for your teacher.
mapday: No headset today? It’s Road Map Day. Read what happened in the book and tap who did it. Then finish two sentences about the whole story.
extra: Build a second scene with the other two models. Say which part of the book it shows.
step1: Pick a scene from the book. Then pick four of these six models that fit it. This list is also in VR, in the Canvas tab.
step2: Put on your headset and open the On-Demand app. Click Explore, type today’s map in Filter environments, and click it. Then click Begin Solo.
step3: Press the top button on your right controller and click Models. Add your four models. Set them up the way they look in your scene.
step4: Point to your scene and say this out loud. My favorite scene is when… I picked it because…
step5: Stand back so it all fits. Open your menu: Library, then Camera, then Take photo. Click the Canvas tab, pick this week’s VR assignment, and click Choose from My Files. Pick your photo, click Use this file, then Submit to Canvas. Look for the green Submitted tag. Then press the Meta button and click Quit.
